decontamination_notes: Real feature from rust-lang/regex PR #1371 (issue #709), merged 2026-07-09, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Adds the declarative regex! macro: a per-call-site Lazy static (exposed through a doc-hidden __private module so no supporting type becomes public API) yielding &Regex, plus a bytes::regex! twin re-exported from a #[macro_export] __bytes_regex. The fix spans src/lib.rs, src/bytes.rs, src/regex/bytes.rs and src/regex/string.rs (system complexity). Workspace sliced at the PR base commit (b9d2cf72) with cargo-prune to the closure of the regex crate (regex root, regex-automata, regex-syntax, regex-test; bench/ and fuzz/ dropped), third-party deps vendored (lock regenerated; offline builds via .cargo/config.toml); rust-2024 image for vendored dev-dep MSRV headroom. MIT/Apache LICENSEs preserved. The upstream crate sets autotests=false with explicit [[test]] targets, so the hidden-test overlay also supplies the task's Cargo.toml with two appended [[test]] entries (vb_macro, vb_reg) — the manifest is otherwise identical to base, the gold patch does not touch it, and the feature requires no manifest change, so agent manifest edits are ignored at grading (documented deliberately). Coverage: 5 fail_to_pass tests in vb_macro.rs, which references the new macros and fails to compile at base — matching and coexistence in one scope, &Regex usability in function positions, pointer-identity proof of one compilation per call site, the bytes twin, and captures/named groups through the macro; 3 pass_to_pass guards in vb_reg.rs pin Regex::new, invalid-pattern is_err (type only, no message), and bytes::Regex::new. Verified: p2p passes at base, everything passes after the gold patch.
